methodology.scope: Only 2026 Trophy XI overalls are reviewed; every 1970–2022 overall remains exactly as restored from the pre-task repository.
methodology.scale: 65 no recorded tournament performance; 69–79 limited/rotation contribution; 80–84 reliable tournament contribution; 85–89 standout; 90–93 elite; 94–96 iconic; 97–99 legendary.
methodology.evidence: Official FIFA minutes, matches, goals, assists, team progression, and position-specific season metrics place each card into a documented Trophy XI performance band.
methodology.exclusions: No roster order, random cycle, historical reputation, club form, EA SPORTS FC rating, or pre-task historical-appearance fallback is used.
methodology.eliteAnchors: Major awards and exceptional tournaments are reviewed explicitly. Golden Ball winner Rodri remains 96, preserving the restored historical 96+ Golden Ball rule.
